<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD defines a standard source array pointing to a prebuilt `.deb` file hosted on GitHub Releases for the limusic project. The URL is from the declared upstream repository (`https://github.com/SimoHypers/limusic`), and the versioned release asset is expected content. The `sha256sums` array contains a valid checksum, so the integrity of the downloaded file will be verified during source extraction — there is no use of 'SKIP' or missing checksums in this case.

During `makepkg --nobuild --nodeps --noprepare`, the only executed code would be at the global scope and potentially in `pkgver()` if defined. However, this PKGBUILD has no `pkgver()` function, and the global scope contains only static variable assignments with no command substitution or dynamic execution (e.g., no `$(...)` or backticks invoking external commands). The `prepare()` and `package()` functions are not executed due to `--noprepare` and `--nobuild`, so the `tar -xf` and `cp` operations are not run at this stage.

Thus, sourcing this PKGBUILD and downloading the source involves no untrusted execution, network calls beyond the declared upstream, or data exfiltration. All operations are consistent with safe, standard AUR packaging practices.
</details>
<summary>
No dangerous execution during source fetch
</summary>
</security_assessment>
